blocks.text: SUBIC BAY FREEPORT – The Philippine Navy on Wednesday (Sept. 23) said it had discussed fleet modernization, capability development and operational sustainment with the United States Navy during a meeting, as naval forces from Southeast Asia and their partner countries gathered here for a weeklong maritime security activity. US Navy Capt. Tammy McCreary, deputy portfolio acquisition executive for the International Fleet Support Program (PMS 326), visited the Philippine Fleet headquarters at Naval Operating Base-Subic on Monday (Sept. 21) and paid a courtesy call on Philippine Fleet commander Commodore Raul Regis.
